description: A small ceramic capacitor (marked "22"). Two of them, one from each crystal leg to GND, help the crystal start and keep a steady beat.
how_to_use: Not polarized. One leg on a crystal leg's column, the other to GND.

plain.what: A tiny capacitor that helps the crystal tick steadily. It has "22" printed on it.
plain.how: It works either way round. One leg next to the crystal, the other to GND.
